title: Concept: Staff identity attached to a customer record
description: A created-by or reviewed-by field naming the officer in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The field names the employee who handled the case, which is the person an impersonation call claims to be, and it exposes staff identities to every client.
applicability: Deployments that render a created-by or reviewed-by field naming the officer into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The field names the employee who handled the case, which is the person an impersonation call claims to be, and it exposes staff identities to every client.
